### News. #### Financial News. # Wealthfront to Announce Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Financial Results on June 4, 2026. For more information please view the Barchart Disclosure Policy here. PALO ALTO, Calif., May 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Wealthfront Corporation (Nasdaq: WLTH), a tech-driven financial platform helping digital natives turn their savings into wealth, today announced that it will release fiscal first quarter 2027 financial results after the U.S. financial markets close on Thursday, June 4, 2026. Access to the live webcast of the call, related earnings materials, as well as monthly metrics through May 2026 will be available through the Investor Relations page on Wealthfront’s website at ir.wealthfront.com. Following the call, a replay of the webcast will be available at the same website and will be accessible for one year. To learn more and get started, visit www.wealthfront.com or download the Wealthfront app. ### Most Popular News. Market Data powered by Barchart Solutions.
